# PID / INVENTORY CODES 

## ED and M6 
```{r}
# PIDs for 
PIDs_245_ED6M <- Metadata_Analysis_RNA_paired %>% 
  filter(Timepoint %in% c("ED", "M6")) %>%
  pull(PID) %>%
  unique()

length(PIDs_245_ED6M) #245

ICs_490_ED6M <- Metadata_Analysis_RNA_paired %>% 
  filter(Timepoint %in% c("ED", "M6")) %>%
  pull(INVENTORY.CODE) %>%
  unique()

length(ICs_490_ED6M) #490 
```

## ED, 2WK, M6
```{r}
# PIDs for the subset of participants that have an additional 2 week sample 
PIDs_40_ED2WK6M <- Metadata_Analysis_RNA_paired %>% 
  filter(Timepoint %in% c("ED", "WK2", "M6")) %>%
  group_by(PID) %>%
  summarise(
    n_timepoints = n_distinct(Timepoint),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_timepoints == 3) %>%
  pull(PID)

# opportunity to write the list of ED-2WK-6M PIDs
#write.csv(PIDs_40_ED2WK6M, "Data/Metadata/Analysis Data/PIDs_Paired_ED2WK6M.csv")

length(PIDs_40_ED2WK6M) #40 

ICs_120_ED2WK6M <- Metadata_Analysis_RNA_paired %>% 
  filter(
    PID %in% PIDs_40_ED2WK6M,
    Timepoint %in% c("ED", "WK2", "M6")) %>%
  pull(INVENTORY.CODE)

length(ICs_120_ED2WK6M)

# opportunity to write the list of ED-2WK-6M Inventory codes
#write.csv(ICs_120_ED2WK6M, "Data/Metadata/Analysis Data/ICs_Paired_ED2WK6M.csv")


```

## Export RNA data 

### ED & 6M
```{r}
RNA_manifest_analysis_ED6M <- RNA_manifest %>%
  filter(INVENTORY.CODE %in% ICs_490_ED6M)

# opportunity to write the list of ED-2WK-6M Inventory codes
write.csv(RNA_manifest_analysis_ED6M, "Data/RNA Data/Analysis Data/RNA_manifest_ED6M_analysis.csv")

## Counts 
AURORA_RNA_Seq_V47_counts_ED6M <- AURORA_RNA_Seq_V47_counts_clean %>%
  filter(INVENTORY.CODE %in% ICs_490_ED6M)

dim(AURORA_RNA_Seq_V47_counts_ED6M) # 490 x 19906

write.csv(AURORA_RNA_Seq_V47_counts_ED6M, "Data/RNA Data/Analysis Data/AURORA_RNAseq_counts_ED6M_analysis.csv")

## Log2 
AURORA_RNA_Seq_V47_log2_ED6M <- AURORA_RNA_Seq_V47_log2_clean %>%
  filter(INVENTORY.CODE %in% ICs_490_ED6M)

dim(AURORA_RNA_Seq_V47_log2_ED6M) # 490 x 19906

write.csv(AURORA_RNA_Seq_V47_log2_ED6M, "Data/RNA Data/Analysis Data/AURORA_RNAseq_log2_ED6M_analysis.csv")

```
